ontology.note: The semantic contract belongs to the ruleset, which declares its own output vocabulary and basis; do not infer one from this widget.

changes.description: Is not and otherwise (experiment 192): a condition can ask that a recorded value is not one value, compiled to N3's log:notEqualTo, and a column can have an otherwise, the value a record takes where no rule gave it one, applied once the columns its rules read are settled and evaluated directly; never over a conflict, and the records that took it are counted by column. Rules shown as coloured blocks with their words and edges (if, or, then, otherwise). On the standard Inspector and dialog (experiment 186): one sentence and Configure…; the records' kind, columns, units, settings and rules in the rules dialog in the standard frame; a published ruleset chosen in a dialog whose preview is its rules, basis and obligations, and a newer version a decision.

evidence.note: Repository regression coverage exists, and the Validation Lab checks this widget exhaustively rather than by sample -- check 23 enumerates the complete input space of all three bundled rulesets, 46 cells, reproducing every conclusion with an independent decision table and verifying the emitted receipt. That is evidence about the rulesets and about this widget's four stages; it does not certify the widget independently, and it says nothing about whether any threshold is right.
